name: Ramp
text: Add a persistent skip link at the top of every page that jumps to the main content. This lets keyboard users bypass repetitive navigation blocks instantly, which is critical for screen reader users who navigate by landmarks. The trade-off is a small visual footprint at the top of the page; we accept this because the accessibility win outweighs the minor aesthetic impact.

name: Reader
text: Persistent skip links fail when JavaScript is off or slow—keyboard users get trapped. A server-side "skip to main content" link at the top of every page, with a fallback hash link, covers all cases without visual clutter. Test with keyboard-only navigation and JavaScript disabled to settle it.
